results.market_title: Will Elon Musk post 140-159 tweets from August 28 to September 4, 2026?
results.reasoning: Recent weekly totals for Musk's X posting have trended in the 160-199 range (e.g., 160-179 for Aug 4-11, 180-199 for Aug 7-14), and search data for the Aug 28-Sep 4 market itself showed the 200-219 bucket priced notably higher (16%) than the 140-159 bucket, implying the crowd expects a count above 160-179 for this specific week. This makes the 140-159 range a below-central outcome, consistent with roughly single-digit-to-low-double-digit probability.
results.key_findings: ["Lines.com: Aug 4-11, 2026 week resolved at 160-179 tweets (Polymarket)","Lines.com: Aug 7-14, 2026 week resolved at 180-199 tweets (Polymarket)","Search snippet showed the 200-219 bucket for the Aug 28-Sep 4 market priced at 16%, higher than the 140-159 bucket's 9%, suggesting the crowd expects higher counts this week","Musk's posting pace has been historically volatile, ranging from ~8-12 posts/day in quiet stretches to much higher during active news cycles"]
